versions.changelog:
Initial release — browser-agent-pro-free 1.0.0

- Enables natural language-driven browser automation: page navigation, screenshots, form filling, basic data scraping.
- Adds sensitive operation confirmation, robots.txt compliance, and structured logging for security and traceability.
- Organizes data (screenshots, scraped info, logs) by date for easy management.
- Provides quick start guides, real-world scenarios, and an FAQ for user onboarding.
- Free version includes feature and usage limits; see documentation for upgrade options.
